meta.name: Hey Prabhu 1080p
meta.description:
A boy in his mid 20s with a strong Twitter following navigates the real world only to realize that online popularity isn't enough to overcome real-life situations. To top it off, his personal life is at an all-time low, because he has started experiencing erectile dysfunction.

Ended · First aired 19 Feb 2019 · India · Language: Hindi · 25 min

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6 | S2 10/10

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Tarun's mother hopes Tarun acts responsibly in his new job at a prestigious magazine. He makes a huge mistake on his very first day. Later that night, he struggles to impress Karishma in bed. What happens next, watch on MX Player.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Magazine editor Mita is livid when she sees Tarun’s mistake. Unfortunately, a personal tragedy, throws her off her game. Despite Arunima’s advice, Tarun provokes Mita, who decides to sack him. What happens next, watch on MX Player.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Mita assigns Tarun petty jobs and asks him to shadow Arunima. Tarun’s mother is shocked to find condoms in his bag. Tarun finds out that a trending embarassing hashtag is actually about him. What happens next, watch on MX Player.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Tarun finds out Karishma’s friend created the hashtag about him. They try revenge sex but Tarun fails again. A drunk Tarun has a huge fight with his mother. What happens next, watch on MX Player.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Tarun remembers he drunk-tweeted, but can’t find the tweet. Mita blasts him for yet another mistake. Tarun and Arunima get close while working together. Arunima confesses she knows Tarun's secret. What happens next, watch on MX Player.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Tarun moves out of home. Arunima tells a secret of her own to Tarun. Tarun’s mother tells her she doesn’t want him to come back home. Arunima pays Tarun a surprise visit. What happens next, watch on MX Player.

videos.title: #ChangeIsConstant
videos.overview: Tarun is feeling all the colors of love but Arunima needs more time to figure things out. Tarun is unaware of the financial issues his parents are facing and has a new flatmate Sikka. Croissant goes digital.

videos.title: #Shook
videos.overview: Tarun is in a state of shock as he finds Karishma in his bed next morning. Arunima questions Mita on Croissant going digital; Tejpal is unhappy with Rimjhim being fired.

videos.title: #DheelaDhakkan
videos.overview: Tarun's family avoids discussing financial issues over family dinner. Charminar humiliates Tarun in front of everyone. Mita annouces offsite in Goa. Sikka advises Tarun to visit a doctor for #Dheela Dhakkan.

videos.title: #LitAF
videos.overview: There is a clash between Arunima and Charminar. Tarun accepts that he is Penne Penis. Sikka gifts Tarun a Russian Hooker, and Tarun's mother gets the shock of her life.

videos.title: #WanderLust
videos.overview: As Tarun gets comfortable with Mita in Goa, Charminaar gets affected. Pia shows interest in Tarun while talking to Arunima, she enters his room and things get steamy. To Tarun's shock, Charminar knows about him being Dheela Dhakkan.

videos.title: #Busted
videos.overview: Tejpal rants about Mita to Tarun. Aarambh observes something fishy about Pia. Tarun and Charminar land into a heated argument. He later gets to know that Pia is Aarambh's sister.

videos.title: #OMG!
videos.overview: Arunima resign's from Croissant. Tarun discusses the idea of categories on Twitter page. Shanti discusses with Ishwar about starting her own tiffin service. Tarun is momentarily happy as his medical reports come back normal, but things go south when he gets to know that Pia is pregnant.

videos.title: #FeelItBro
videos.overview: Pia blasts Tarun and calms down when she realizes that he is Dheela Dhakkan. Sikka realizes that he has been wasting money. Sparks rekindle between Tarun and Arunima, as he helps her with Fact-Chic’s Twitter handle. Charminar is busy plotting something.

videos.title: #OwnIt
videos.overview: Rimjhim discusses about Pia-Tarun matter to Tejpal, as she feels concerned about Arunima. Tarun is finally having a good time with parents but soon discovers about their financial troubles and feels guilty. Charminar gets Tarun fired. Arunima finds an unexpected investor.

videos.title: #Karma
videos.overview: Charminar is busted. Tarun and Arunima rekindle their love. Ishwar and Shanti celebrate Tarun's new job at Sikka’s house, but things go topsy turvy when Aarambh and Arunima come.
